Class.name: IHC.EAI.KPI.Controller.TransactionCount
Class.Description: Class that stores a snaphsot of daily transaction count data

Method.name: CreateSnapshots
CreateSnapshot
Method.Description:
Create a Transaction Count Snapshot
Params:
pCountType:
Out (Default)
In
pCountDate:
Format is Cache internal format
Example: 64098
If empty, process count for yesterday
Do ##class(IHC.EAI.KPI.Controller.TransactionCount).CreateSnapshot("",,,1)

Method.name: CreateSnapshotJSON
SendSnapshot
Method.Implementation:
Set tStatus = $$$OK Try { Set tRequest = ##class(IHC.EAI.KPI.Message.Request).%New() Set tRequest.Command = "PUT" Set tRequest.Name = ..#MetricsRequestName Set tRequest.URL = ..#MetricsAPIURL // CONFIG? Set tRequest.JSONStream = ##class(%Stream.GlobalCharacter).%New() Set tStatus = tRequest.JSONStream.CopyFrom(pJSONStream) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tStatus = ##class(Ens.Director).CreateBusinessService(..#MetricsService,.tBusSvc) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
Set tStatus = tBusSvc.ProcessInput(tRequest,.tResponse) $$$ThrowOnError(tStatus)
} Catch eException { Set tStatus = eException.AsStatus() } Quit tStatus

Params:

IN
